commentary.text: 90+6' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+5' Alex Valle (Como) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Daniele Doveri no option but to blow his whistle.
90+3' Jacobo Ramon (Como) receives a good pass just outside the box, unleashes a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
90+2' Alex Valle (Como) wins the ball after the corner kick and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players.
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
90' Good work from Como as they win a corner.
90' Nico Paz (Como) collects a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender. Como will take a corner kick.
89' Jens Odgaard (Bologna) is flagged for offside.
87' Jacobo Ramon (Como) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Daniele Doveri has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
85' Thijs Dallinga (Bologna) latches on to an accurate pass on the edge of the box and immediately unleashes a shot which is wide of the mark.
82' The game has come to an end for Charalampos Lykogiannis. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Juan Miranda (Bologna).
82' The corner kick from Nadir Zortea (Bologna) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.
81' Wow, what an escape. Nicolo Cambiaghi (Bologna) has an effort from inside the box but it's brilliantly blocked. The ball goes out of play. Bologna are awarded a corner kick.
81' Today's match ends for Lucas Da Cunha who will be replaced by Martin Baturina (Como).
78' Daniele Doveri shows a yellow card to Tommaso Pobega (Bologna), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
75' Referee Daniele Doveri has finally had enough of Cesc Fabregas and brandishes a yellow card at him!
75' Today's referee Daniele Doveri rightly decides to book Jacobo Ramon (Como) for his harsh tackle.
73' We are about to witness a subsitution. Thijs Dallinga (Bologna) for Santiago Castro.
73' Daniele Doveri blows for a foul after Jacobo Ramon (Como) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
69' Alex Valle (Como) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Daniele Doveri blows for a foul.
67' Jhon Lucumi (Bologna) sees a yellow card from Daniele Doveri after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
67' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) inside the box following a slide rule pass.
65' Vincenzo Italiano has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Tommaso Pobega (Bologna) replacing Nikola Moro.
65' The referee allows time for a substitution. Giovanni Fabbian will be replaced by Jens Odgaard (Bologna).
64' The game is interrupted as Santiago Castro (Bologna) is flagged offside.
63' Como have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
61' Nico Paz (Como) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Daniele Doveri blows for a foul.
59' 1 - 0 What a hit! Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) shows good composure inside the box to fire a first-time shot into the bottom right corner. 1:0.
58' A promising move ends with a clever pass to Jesus Rodriguez (Como), who hits a first-time shot at goal that rises just over the bar.
57' Cesc Fabregas decides to make a substitution. Anastasios Douvikas will be replaced by Alvaro Morata (Como).
57' It's time for a substitution. Nicolas-Gerrit Kuhn (Como) comes on in place of Mergim Vojvoda.

56' A long pass finds Marc Oliver Kempf (Como), and he decides to test the keeper from long range. The shot flies low towards the middle of the goal, but Lukasz Skorupski reacts well to make a good save.
55' A corner kick by Bologna is thwarted by the well prepared Jean Butez (Como).
54' Remo Freuler (Bologna) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. Bologna have a corner.
50' This shall not pass! Nico Paz (Como) lines up a shot from the edge of the box and goes for goal, but the effort is well blocked by a defender.
47' Bologna take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
47' The corner is floated into the centre of the box, but a placed header from Giovanni Fabbian (Bologna) flies well wide of the right post.
47' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Bologna comes to nothing.
46' Nicolo Cambiaghi (Bologna) receives a sweet pass inside the box, but his effort on goal is blocked by the defender. Now Bologna have a corner.
46' Cesc Fabregas has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Sergi Roberto comes on the pitch for Maximo Perrone (Como).
46' Half-time substitution. Martin Vitik (Bologna) will not participate anymore and Jhon Lucumi is coming on.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+2' The match has reached half-time.

45+1' Nice move, nice attempt! Mergim Vojvoda (Como) is teed up with a simple pass after a nice flowing move. His first time shot from mid-range looks like it's going in but curls just wide of the right post.
45+1' There will be a minimum of 1 min. of added time.
43' Dangerous play by Nico Paz (Como). Daniele Doveri blows his whistle for a foul.
41' Jesus Rodriguez (Como) latches onto a cross inside the box but fires a poor effort well wide of the left post.
39' Nico Paz (Como) gets to the ball from the resulting corner and tries his luck with a shot, but one of the defenders steps in to block the effort.
39' Lucas Da Cunha (Como) takes the corner.
38' Alex Valle (Como) produces a dangerous low pass into the penalty area, but the defence manage to cut it out. The ball is out of play. Como win a corner kick.
37' The foul by Martin Vitik (Bologna) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Daniele Doveri.
37' Flag goes up against Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
35' Daniele Doveri shows the yellow card to Ivan Smolcic (Como) for a heavy challenge.
33' The corner is swung in but Bologna can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
31' Bologna quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.

31' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot towards the roof of the net, but Jean Butez pulls off a brilliant save. The referee blows his whistle, Bologna are awarded a corner kick.
29' Nicolo Cambiaghi (Bologna) attempted to create a dangerous situation in front of goal by sending a cross into the box, but the defence easily dealt with the threat.
28' Maximo Perrone (Como) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Daniele Doveri ignores the protests.
27' Problems for Cesc Fabregas as Ignace Van der Brempt is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Ivan Smolcic (Como) replaces him.
25' Daniele Doveri couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Anastasios Douvikas (Como) and blew his whistle.
23' Jesus Rodriguez (Como) collects a pass inside the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
22' Nico Paz (Como) takes a neat pass, dummies a defender and slams the ball well wide of the left post from the edge of the box.
18' Alex Valle (Como) clips an inviting cross into the box, but there's no one in a position to get on the end of it.
17' Como take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
16' Ignace Van der Brempt (Como) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Daniele Doveri blows his whistle for a foul.
12' Torbjorn Lysaker Heggem (Bologna) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
10' Great teamplay by Como as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
7' Maximo Perrone (Como) commits a rough challenge and Daniele Doveri blows his whistle for an infringement.
6' Giovanni Fabbian (Bologna) reacts well near the penalty spot to connect with the resulting corner, but fails to direct his header into the back of the net. The ball floats high over the bar.
5' Nikola Moro (Bologna) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.

5' Santiago Castro (Bologna) receives a precise low pass inside the box, controls the ball and drills it towards the right post. Unfortunately for him, Jean Butez makes a great save to stop his effort. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Bologna.
2' A yellow card for a tackle by Nicolo Cambiaghi (Bologna). Daniele Doveri doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Como will have the kick-off.
Daniele Doveri will supervise the game today.
